n: eCraft2Learn AI programming guide and PWA
t: A seven chapter Snap! guide to AI programming with speech, vision, and neural nets.
steps: Find the eCraft2Learn AI guide on the project site.
Open it in Chrome or Edge.
Optionally install the progressive web app.
Import the Snap! libraries for Chapter 1.
Allow the camera and microphone for chapters that need them.
Check which blocks call cloud services and need API keys.
Test Chapters 4, 6, and 7 for speed on your devices.
